names.note: Name page 9945 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Арефа (Еремкин), мч.»; the grade is stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Арефы». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and a Cyrillic grep for «Еремкин» over every `saint.json` returns nothing; the corpus's three other men of the name — `arethas-mitrenin`, `arethas-of-the-kyiv-caves`, `arethas-the-recluse` — stand on other days and none bears this surname.

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)», one year for the whole company of eight; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 июля ст. ст. — «Прмч. Василия , прмцц. Анастасии и Елены , мчч. Арефы , Иоанна , Иоанна , Иоанна и мц. Мавры (1937).»

attestations.note: The first of the four men the day's eleventh entry heads «мчч.», martyrs, in an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF EIGHT which BRIEF.md §4 makes eight folders. The line and name page 9945 agree: «мч.» on both, with no rank in the church, so `martyr` is all that is written and NO `office` IS WRITTEN. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind the entry, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. The day page prints no hymn under any of the eight names.
